coverage.summary: 24 substantive rhythm examples: six each for note values, attack grouping, holds/rests and A/B relationship. Eight per artist; all source clocks exact. Synthetic playback shares the displayed notation.

limitations: Synthetic playback is generated from the same notation, not independent original-recording evidence.
Notated hold lengths are not measured acoustic sustain.
Written rests are voice-specific; uncovered intervals are union-of-notated-holds complements.
Musical grouping, groove and phrase function remain human judgments.
sampling: First feasible unique-song assignment under pre-frozen feature criteria. Original captures preferred, then frozen population order. No musical listening/reroll.
